title: A Skill is a folder
text: Before it acts. This one is called demand draft. It's one file skill. MD holds the whole instruction set written in plain language, no hidden logic. Claude reads it, then acts. The file is the program.

title: Read, execute, return
text: The instructions live in a step section. Claude reads each step in order and executes it. Read the file, execute each step, return the result. Linear, no branching unless a step says otherwise.

title: The four-part gate
text: One instruction inside it is specific. Before any letter gets drafted, four checks have to clear: privilege, rule 408, waiver, and admission.
